name: workflow-plugin-vectorstore
description: Vector database integration (Pinecone, Milvus) for RAG pipelines
author: GoCodeAlone

required_secrets.name: PINECONE_API_KEY
required_secrets.description: Pinecone API key (provider: pinecone). Other vector providers (e.g. Milvus) use their own auth. Referenced as ${PINECONE_API_KEY}.

stepSchemas.description: Upsert vectors (with IDs, values, and metadata) into the configured vector store index.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Vectors
configFields.description: Array of vector objects, each with 'id' (string), 'values' ([]float), and optional 'metadata' (map).

stepSchemas.description: Perform a similarity search against the vector store and return the top-K nearest matches.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Query Vector
configFields.description: The query vector (array of float values) to search with.

configFields.label: Top K
configFields.description: Maximum number of results to return.

configFields.label: Metadata Filter
configFields.description: Optional metadata filter map to narrow the search.

stepSchemas.description: Fetch vectors by their IDs from the vector store.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Vector IDs
configFields.description: List of vector IDs to fetch.

stepSchemas.description: Delete vectors by IDs or by a metadata filter. Exactly one of 'ids' or 'filter' must be provided; supplying both is an error.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Vector IDs
configFields.description: List of vector IDs to delete. Mutually exclusive with 'filter'.

configFields.label: Metadata Filter
configFields.description: Metadata filter for bulk deletion. Mutually exclusive with 'ids'.

outputs.description: Number of vectors deleted (set when deleting by IDs).
True when deletion was performed by metadata filter.

stepSchemas.description: Create a new vector index in the configured vector store.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Index Name
configFields.description: Name of the index to create.

configFields.label: Dimension
configFields.description: Vector dimension (must match your embedding model's output size).

configFields.label: Cloud Provider
configFields.description: Cloud provider to host the index on.

configFields.label: Distance Metric
configFields.description: Similarity metric used for vector comparison.

configFields.label: Region
configFields.description: Cloud region to deploy the index in (e.g. 'us-east-1').

outputs.description: Name of the newly created index.

stepSchemas.description: List all vector indexes available in the configured vector store.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

outputs.description: List of index descriptors, each with 'name', 'dimension', 'metric', and 'vector_count'.

stepSchemas.description: Describe an existing vector index, including its dimension, metric, and vector count.

configFields.label: Module
configFields.description: Name of the vectorstore.provider module instance to use.

configFields.label: Index Name
configFields.description: Name of the index to describe.

outputs.description: Distance metric used by the index.
Total number of vectors stored in the index.

secret_targets.description: Stored as GitHub Actions secrets when workflows run on GitHub.
Stored as GitLab CI/CD variables when workflows run on GitLab.
Stored in Vault for application/runtime retrieval.
Stored in a local file-backed secret store.
Stored in the local OS keychain.
Provided by the local process environment.
